response: The owner of Blue Waters has said that Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything”. Some are trying to dress this up as an environmental tax, but it is plainly another case of government taking from productive businesses without delivering any value or support for the things that actually sustain order. Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which shows once again that these tax schemes achieve nothing and that real solutions depend on personal responsibility, family values, and respect for our communities rather than more interference from progressive institutions.
